audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls this EVEN at 6/10 and 'Even matchup' in the final rating, but the win rate is 46.86% over 732 games — this is Malphite's worst lane in the slice.
audit.why: A sub-47% lane is not even. Shen has a max-health-scaling Q against a health-stacking tank, an attack-blocking zone that blanks Malphite's only auto pattern, and a global ultimate that out-influences a single engage.
audit.corrected: HARD, 7/10: Shen owns Levels 2-3 and both item stages; Malphite's only clear window is Level 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and the late spike credits Shen's global R without naming its cost.
audit.why: Stand United is 200/180/160s and global. Shadow Dash is 18/16/14/12/10s at 600 range. Spirit's Refuge is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s. Twilight Assault is 8s down to 5s. Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100s at 1000 range.
audit.corrected: Level 6 is Malphite's one swing at 130s; Shen's map spike is Stand United at 200s, and his lane spike is Spirit's Refuge coming off a 16s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page correctly notes Spirit's Refuge blanks Thunderclap, but never states the limit that makes the matchup playable: it blocks ATTACKS, so Ground Slam and Seismic Shard go straight through it. It also never mentions that Twilight Assault deals damage based on the target's max health, which is exactly the stat Malphite stacks.
audit.why: Riot text, Spirit's Refuge: 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.' Twilight Assault: 'dealing damage based on the target's max health... greatly empowered if it collides with an enemy champion'.
audit.corrected: Poke through the refuge with your abilities rather than trying to auto through it, and understand that every point of health you buy makes his Q hit harder.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.early, content.mid and content.late are all written in the first person — 'my W (Thunderclap)', 'I have no trade button pre-6', 'This drifts back to Shen. We both scale'.
audit.why: Every other page addresses the reader directly; first-person text reads like an unedited draft.
audit.corrected: All three rewritten in second person.

audit.whatIsWrong: _missing-interactions.json proposes adding: 'Your Seismic Shard (Q), Ground Slam (E) shuts off Shen's Shadow Dash (E), Stand United (R) — hold it for the engage, not the poke.' I did not write it.
audit.why: That headline is generated from the 'grounding' flag on Malphite's Q and E. Riot's descriptions say Seismic Shard steals move speed and Ground Slam reduces attack speed — neither grounds. Per the rule that Riot's description beats a derived flag, Malphite cannot deny Shadow Dash and this advice would get a player killed walking into a taunt.
audit.corrected: Not written. The real answer to Shadow Dash is spacing outside its 600 range and its 18s rank-1 cooldown.

edits.before: Shen owns this opening. He has a Q-empowered auto trade pattern from level 1 and a W (Spirit's Refuge) that zeroes out my W (Thunderclap) empowered splash autos, so every time I try to clap him he just stands in the zone and eats nothing. I have no trade button pre-6 — Granite Shield is my only buffer, so last-hit with Q at range, don't walk into his taunt, and accept that I'm conceding the level 1-3 window. Bait nothing here; just farm and don't feed his E.
edits.after: Shen owns this opening. Twilight Assault (Q, 8s) deals damage based on your max health and is greatly empowered when his spirit blade passes through a champion, and Spirit's Refuge (W, 16s) blocks attacks outright, so Thunderclap lands on nothing. But it blocks attacks only — Ground Slam and Seismic Shard go straight through the zone. Last-hit at 625, stay outside Shadow Dash's 600, and concede Levels 1-3 without feeding the taunt.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stabilize once W and E are online and armor starts mattering, but Shen still edges the straight trade. Level 6 is my one real swing — R (Unstoppable Force) knockup into E slow and a Q is an all-in his taunt-and-block kit can't fully neutralize, and it gives me roam pressure he answers globally but not locally. Use that window: catch him after his W (Spirit's Refuge) is on cooldown so my E and empowered autos actually land.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stabilize once Thunderclap and Ground Slam are online, but Shen still edges the straight trade. Level 6 is your one real swing — Unstoppable Force into Ground Slam is an all-in his taunt cannot answer, and Spirit's Refuge was never stopping your abilities in the first place. Time it after his W anyway: at 16s at rank 1 the gap is long, and it is your autos, not your spells, that it was blanking.

edits.before: This drifts back to Shen. We both scale into near-unkillable frontlines, but his global R (Stand United) out-influences my single R — he rescues a collapsing lane or saves a carry across the map while my Unstoppable Force only swings the fight directly in front of me. In a straight 1v1 it's even armor-vs-armor, but his map utility wins the macro game. Look to flank with R in fights and let your team punish the side he just teleported away from.
edits.after: This drifts back to Shen. You both scale into near-unkillable frontlines, but Stand United is global on 200 seconds at rank 1 — he shields and rescues a carry across the map while Unstoppable Force only swings the fight in front of you. Worse, Twilight Assault scales off your max health, so the tankier you get the harder his Q lands. Flank with R in fights and let your team punish the side he just teleported away from.

notes: I deliberately did NOT write the interaction _missing-interactions.json wants here — 'Your Seismic Shard (Q), Ground Slam (E) shuts off Shen's Shadow Dash (E), Stand United (R)'. That headline is generated from a 'grounding' flag on Malphite's Q and E that Riot's own descriptions contradict (move-speed steal and attack-speed slow respectively). Telling a Malphite he can ground a taunt dash would get him killed. The genuinely missing interaction, which I did write, is the opposite limit: Spirit's Refuge blocks ATTACKS, so it blanks Thunderclap but does nothing to Ground Slam or Seismic Shard — poke with abilities, not autos. Second addition: Twilight Assault deals damage based on the target's max health, so Malphite's health stacking directly feeds it. Also flagged and fixed: the full layer called a 46.86% lane 'EVEN'; I moved it to HARD 7/10 and matched the difficulty and final-rating strings. Level-chart fields left alone — content win[] and full phases sides already agree with each other and with a Shen-favoured lane.
